title: Kobweb conf.yaml
description: Configuration for a Kobweb project, especially its server behavior.

site.description: Properties that affect how the site is presented to the user.

title.description: The title of the site, used as the page's <title>.

basePath.description: A subfolder that all site content lives under. For example, with "/a/b/c", the root index.html is served at `mysite.com/a/b/c/`. Rarely needed, but some server configurations nest sites in a subdirectory.

files.description: Files and paths the Kobweb server needs to serve the site.

dev.description: Files used by the dev server, which serves a single html file representing the whole project.

contentRoot.description: The path to serve content from, which includes the Kobweb index.html file.

script.description: The path to the JavaScript file generated from the site's Kotlin code.

api.description: The path to the API jar generated by the project, if any. Used to extend the behavior of the Kobweb server.

prod.description: Files used by the production server.

script.description: The path to the minimized JavaScript file generated from the site's Kotlin code.

siteRoot.description: The path to the root of the exported static site.

port.description: The port the server listens on. In dev mode, if the port is in use, the next free one is used instead.

logging.description: Configuration for logging. By default, logs append to a single file which rolls over at the end of each day.

level.description: The minimum level of log messages to show. DEBUG is a good balance of verbosity and usefulness. TRACE is very verbose, and mostly useful for debugging tricky issues locally (e.g. CORS misconfigurations or unexpected 403s).

enableConsoleLogging.description: If true, logs are written to stdout/stderr.

enableFileLogging.description: If true, logs are also written to a file. If false, the other file-related logging properties are ignored.

interceptSystemOutput.description: If true, `println` / `System.out.println` and `System.err.println` calls are rerouted to the info and warn log streams, respectively.

logRoot.description: The directory where logs are stored. If it will contain files other than logs, consider setting `clearLogsOnStart` to false.

clearLogsOnStart.description: If true, all files under `logRoot` are deleted when a dev server starts. Be careful if `logRoot` contains non-log files!

logFileBaseName.description: The base name of the log file. A suffix is added automatically, and archived logs reuse the base name.

maxFileCount.description: The maximum number of log files to keep before old ones are deleted. Null (or 0) means unbounded.

totalSizeCap.description: The maximum total size of all log files before old ones are deleted, as a number followed by a unit (B, K, M, G, KB, MB, GB, KiB, MiB or GiB, case-insensitive). Null (or "0B") means unbounded.

compressHistory.description: If true, log files are compressed when they roll over.

cors.description: Configuration for CORS. See also: https://ktor.io/docs/cors.html

hosts.description: Hosts allowed to make cross-origin requests to this site.

name.description: The hostname (and optional port), e.g. "somesite.com:1234". Don't include the scheme; use `schemes` for that. "*" allows any host, which should be avoided in production.

schemes.description: The HTTP schemes allowed for this host, e.g. "http". Must not be empty unless `name` is "*".

subdomains.description: Subdomains to allow, e.g. "media" to allow "media.varabyte.com".

redirects.description: URL redirects. Visiting a `from` path makes the server issue a 301 redirect to the `to` path.

from.description: A regex matching the path to redirect, e.g. "/old/([^/]*)". It must start with a leading slash, or it will never match.

to.description: The path to redirect to. Capture groups from `from` can be substituted using `$1`, `$2`, etc., e.g. "/new/$1".

streaming.description: Configuration for streaming APIs, which are built on WebSockets. See also: https://ktor.io/docs/websocket.html

pingPeriod.description: The duration between pings, or "0s" to disable pings. Uses Kotlin duration syntax (e.g. "15s", "1m 30s") or ISO-8601 (e.g. "PT15S").

timeout.description: The write/ping timeout after which a connection is closed. Uses Kotlin duration syntax (e.g. "15s", "1m 30s") or ISO-8601 (e.g. "PT15S").

nativeLibraries.description: Explicit name-to-path mappings for native libraries loaded by API routes. Rarely needed; Kobweb usually finds the right file on its own.

name.description: The generic library name the JVM requests, e.g. "test".

path.description: The path to the library file to load, e.g. "jni/linux/libtest.so".
